node.label: Output
node.description: x + y + a + b + c + d

object.script:
function onTick() x = input.getNumber(1) y = input.getNumber(2)
target_x = input.getNumber(3) target_y = input.getNumber(4)
dx = target_x - x dy = target_y - y
distance = (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) ^ 0.5 azimuth = 90 - math.atan(dy / dx) * 180 / math.pi
if dx < 0 then azimuth = azimuth + 180 end
output.setNumber(1, azimuth) output.setNumber(2, distance / 1000) end

min_charge = 0.5 max_charge = 0.9
clutch = 0 clutch_step = 0.01
function onTick() charge = input.getNumber(1)
if charge < min_charge then clutch = math.min(clutch + clutch_step, 1) else if charge > max_charge then clutch = math.max(clutch - clutch_step, 0) end end
output.setNumber(1, clutch) end
function onTick() output.setNumber(1, 4 * input.getNumber(1)) output.setNumber(2, 4 * input.getNumber(2)) end

min_distance = 10 min_signature_distance = 1000 remove_delay = 1000 lock_shift = 0 prev_lock = 0 screen_range = 4000 targets = {}
function onTick() current_lock = input.getNumber(29) course = input.getNumber(30)
if current_lock ~= prev_lock then lock_shift = 0 prev_lock = current_lock end
lock_target = current_lock + lock_shift
for channel = 1, 7 do if input.getBool(channel) then targets_found = #targets channel_shift = 4 * (channel - 1) is_new = true
r1 = input.getNumber(channel_shift + 1)
if r1 > min_distance then phi1 = input.getNumber(channel_shift + 2) - course
if phi1 < 0 then phi1 = 1 + phi1 end
target = {distance = r1, azimuth = phi1, ticks = 0, delta_x = r1 * math.sin(phi1 * 2 * math.pi), delta_y = r1 * math.cos(phi1 * 2 * math.pi)}
i = 1 while (i <= targets_found and is_new) do other = targets[i]
r2 = other.distance phi2 = other.azimuth
if (r1 ^ 2 + r2 ^ 2 - 2 * r1 * r2 * math.cos((phi2 - phi1) * 2 * math.pi)) ^ 0.5 < min_signature_distance then targets[i] = target is_new = false end
i = i + 1 end
if is_new then
i = 1 while i <= targets_found and targets[i].distance < r1 do i = i + 1 end
table.insert(targets, i, target)
if i <= lock_target then lock_shift = lock_shift + 1 end end end end end
i = 1 while i <= #targets do ticks = targets[i].ticks
if ticks > remove_delay then table.remove(targets, i)
if i < lock_target then lock_shift = lock_shift - 1 end else targets[i].ticks = ticks + 1 i = i + 1 end end
targets_found = #targets output.setNumber(3, targets_found)
for i = 1, targets_found - 1 do next_target = i + 1
first = targets[i] second = targets[next_target]
if first.distance > second.distance then targets[i] = second targets[next_target] = first
if lock_target == i then lock_shift = lock_shift + 1 else if lock_target == next_target then lock_shift = lock_shift - 1 end end end end
if lock_target > 0 and targets_found >= lock_target then target = targets[lock_target]
output.setNumber(1, target.distance / 1000) output.setNumber(2, target.azimuth * 360) output.setNumber(4, target.delta_x) output.setNumber(5, target.delta_y) else lock_shift = 0 end end
function onDraw() size = screen.getWidth() scale = size / (2 * screen_range) center = size / 2
screen.setColor(0, 255, 0) screen.drawLine(0, center, size - 1, center) screen.drawLine(center, 0, center, size - 1)
screen.setColor(255, 0, 0)
for i = 1, #targets do x = center + targets[i].delta_x * scale y = center - targets[i].delta_y * scale
screen.drawCircleF(x, y, 1) end end

node.label: Course Lock
node.description: Torpedo is guided by radar if false

object.script:
launched = false tick = 0 arm_tick = 1000
function onTick() if input.getBool(1) then launched = true end
if launched then tick = tick + 1 end
if tick > arm_tick then output.setBool(1, true) else output.setBool(1, false) end end

function onTick() course_lock = input.getBool(1) target_x = input.getNumber(1) target_y = input.getNumber(2) target_course = input.getNumber(3) / 360 depth = input.getNumber(4) course = input.getNumber(5) x = input.getNumber(6) y = input.getNumber(7)
delta_x = target_x - x delta_y = target_y - y
if not course_lock then target_course = 0.25 - math.atan(delta_y / delta_x) / (2 * math.pi)
if delta_x < 0 then target_course = target_course + 0.5 end end
if target_course < 0.5 then target_course = -target_course else target_course = 1 - target_course end
turn = course - target_course if turn > 0.5 then turn = 1 - turn else if turn < -0.5 then turn = 1 + turn end end
distance = (delta_x ^ 2 + delta_y ^ 2) ^ 0.5
output.setNumber(1, math.max(-1, math.min(1, turn * 10))) output.setNumber(2, depth) output.setNumber(3, distance) end

launched = false max_throttle = 1 throttle = 0
function onTick() if input.getBool(1) then launched = true end
if launched then throttle = max_throttle end
output.setNumber(1, throttle) end

pitch_p = 60 depth_p = 0.01 roll_p = 4 max_pitch = 0.1 ascent_distance = 200
function onTick() pitch = input.getNumber(1) roll = input.getNumber(2) altitude = input.getNumber(3) input_depth = input.getNumber(4) distance = input.getNumber(5)
roll_correction = math.min(0.5, math.max(-0.5, roll * roll_p))
if distance > ascent_distance then target_altitude = -input_depth else target_altitude = -distance * input_depth / ascent_distance end
target_pitch = math.min(max_pitch, math.max(-max_pitch, (target_altitude - altitude) * depth_p)) pitch_correction = math.min(0.5, math.max(-0.5, (target_pitch - pitch) * pitch_p))
output.setNumber(1, pitch_correction - roll_correction) output.setNumber(2, pitch_correction + roll_correction) end
